The S3 presign runner (`s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign`) refreshes external attachment links every 12 hours.

It is wired into server startup via `startBackgroundRunners` at `server/server.go:129`. The runner itself is created at `server/server.go:162`.

h01.
s3presign.Runner — every 12 hours — server/server.go:129

The S3 presign runner (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`) re-presigns S3 attachment URLs before they expire (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`). `Server.Start` hooks it in by calling `startBackgroundRunners`, which constructs the runner, runs it once, then starts the 12-hour loop.
